Christopher Columbus

**Alternative Ending:**

Frederick’s hand hovered over the vial, the liquid inside shimmering with an unnatural, pearlescent glow. The draft from the hidden chamber had died down, leaving a heavy silence in its wake. He looked at the runes, then at the vial, and finally at his own trembling hands. He thought of the centuries of loneliness, the inevitable loss of everyone he loved, and the burden of watching history repeat itself without him.

With a sudden, decisive motion, Frederick didn't drink. Instead, he poured the potion onto the ancient altar. The liquid hissed as it touched the stone, dissolving the runes and causing the book to crumble into dust. The secret to eternal life was gone, but so was the temptation. Frederick smiled, feeling the weight of mortality lift from his shoulders, and walked out of the chamber, ready to live his one, precious life to the fullest.
